name: Maxwell Timothy
bio: Maxwell Timothy is a content marketing expert and AI technology writer with 6+ years of experience covering artificial intelligence, focusing on AI customer support, CX, and conversational messaging tools. His writing has appeared on MakeUseOf, MSN, Flipboard, Make Tech Easier, and NewsBreak, and he's authored an eBook on ChatGPT that has been used in university coursework. He works in Growth and Marketing at Heyy, and has previously written content for Chatbase and Crisp — both reviewed on this site. Every tool here, including those three, is scored against the same public rubric documented on the methodology page.
credentials: Content Marketing Expert — AI Customer Support & CX
